Requirement Description: The test suite shall locate a web element by its HTML id using Selenium By.id().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element with a known id exists, when the test calls findElement(By.id(...)), then Selenium returns the matching WebElement.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall locate a web element by its HTML name attribute using Selenium By.name().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element with a known name attribute exists, when the test calls findElement(By.name(...)), then Selenium returns the matching WebElement.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall locate a web element using a CSS selector.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element matches the supplied CSS selector, when the test calls findElement(By.css(...)), then Selenium returns the matching WebElement.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall locate a web element using an XPath expression.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element matches the supplied XPath expression, when the test calls findElement(By.xpath(...)), then Selenium returns the matching WebElement.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall verify that each located element is displayed.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a WebElement has been located, when isDisplayed() is evaluated, then the test shall assert that the expected visibility state is returned.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall retrieve multiple matching elements using findElements().
Acceptance Criteria: Given multiple elements match a locator, when findElements() is called, then Selenium returns a collection containing the matching WebElements.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall verify the number of elements returned by findElements().
Acceptance Criteria: Given a page contains a known set of matching elements, when the collection is retrieved, then its size shall match the expected count.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall enter text into an editable input using sendKeys().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an enabled input field is present, when sendKeys() is called with test data, then the input shall contain the entered text.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall clear the existing value of an input using clear().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an input contains text, when clear() is called, then the input value shall be empty.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall activate a button or link using click().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an interactable element is present, when click() is called, then the expected page or application state change shall occur.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall submit a form using Selenium WebElement form submission where applicable.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid form is populated, when submit() is invoked on a form control, then the form submission outcome shall be verified.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall retrieve the visible text of an element using getText().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element contains visible text, when getText() is called, then the returned text shall match the expected value.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall retrieve an element attribute using getAttribute().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element has a specified attribute, when getAttribute() is called with that attribute name, then the returned value shall match the expected value.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall retrieve a DOM attribute using getDomAttribute().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element has a DOM attribute, when getDomAttribute() is called, then the returned attribute value shall be verified.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall retrieve a DOM property using getDomProperty().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element exposes a DOM property, when getDomProperty() is called, then the returned property value shall be verified.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall verify whether an element is displayed using isDisplayed().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element is visible or hidden, when isDisplayed() is evaluated, then the result shall match the expected visibility state.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall verify whether an element is enabled using isEnabled().
Acceptance Criteria: Given an element is enabled or disabled, when isEnabled() is evaluated, then the result shall match the expected enabled state.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall verify whether a checkbox, radio button, or option is selected using isSelected().
Acceptance Criteria: Given a selectable element has a known selection state, when isSelected() is evaluated, then the result shall match the expected selection state.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall retrieve all elements matching a locator using findElements().
Acceptance Criteria: Given one or more elements match the locator, when findElements() is called, then a collection of matching WebElements shall be returned.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall iterate through a collection of WebElements.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a collection of matching elements is returned, when the test iterates through it, then each element shall be processed without skipping the collection.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall extract and validate text from multiple elements.
Acceptance Criteria: Given multiple elements contain text, when their text is retrieved, then each value shall be compared with the expected result or validation rule.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall count the number of matching elements.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a page contains matching elements, when the collection length is evaluated, then the count shall match the expected number.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall locate an HTML select element.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a select element exists, when Selenium locates it, then the returned WebElement shall identify the dropdown.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall retrieve the available options from an HTML select element.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a select element contains options, when its option elements are retrieved, then the test shall be able to inspect the available options.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall select an option by its visible text using WebDriver interactions.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an option with the expected visible text exists, when that option is selected, then it shall become the selected option.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall select an option by its value attribute using WebDriver interactions.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an option with the expected value exists, when that option is selected, then it shall become the selected option.

Requirement Description: The test suite shall verify the currently selected dropdown option.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an option has been selected, when the selected option is inspected, then its visible text and/or value shall match the expected selection.
